# jobrunner

Small job runner with a configurable bounded exponential retry policy.

## Retry policy

`run_job` receives a `RetryConfig` and an injected `Sleeper`. The
`max_attempts` value includes the initial call. Only `RetryError::Transient`
failures are retried; permanent failures are returned immediately.

Retries wait for `base_delay_ms`, then double the delay after each failed
attempt. Every delay is capped at `max_delay_ms` (including the first retry),
so the policy remains bounded even for very large values. A configuration
should use `max_attempts >= 1`.

For tests and other callers that should not actually wait, `FakeSleeper`
records each requested delay in its public `sleeps` field.
